stick_law_structural_checks_on_public_do.question: Law - structural checks on public-domain US law, sealed

ticks.claim: [a contract's elements] Offer, acceptance, consideration, capacity and legality - all five present makes a structurally valid contract (sealed through law.LAW_VERIFY). The checklist, not the judgment of a court.
[the age to serve - President] The Constitution sets 35 as the minimum for President (Art. II sec 1); age 36 meets it (sealed).
[Senator] 30 is the minimum for a Senator (Art. I sec 3); age 30 meets it exactly (sealed).
[FLSA overtime] 48 hours at $20 regular: 8 hours over 40, paid at time-and-a-half, is 8 x 20 x 1.5 = $240 overtime (sealed). The arithmetic of the Fair Labor Standards Act.

[the Miranda warning] All four elements present - the right to silence, the use against you, the right to an attorney, and appointment if you cannot afford one (sealed). The completeness of the warning, checked.

[the frame, and its hard edge] These are STRUCTURAL and arithmetic checks on US federal, public-domain and constitutional text. They are NOT legal advice. Whether a contract is enforceable, how a statute applies to the facts, how a court would rule - all of that is interpretation, and the engine does not do it.
ticks.source: US Constitution; Fair Labor Standards Act; Miranda v. Arizona (1966); law.LAW_VERIFY

ticks.claim: [what is declined, loudly] Legal interpretation, the application of law to particular facts, case outcomes, state and local law, and anything that would be advice are DECLINED - consult a licensed attorney. The engine certifies the structure, never the counsel.
